main_text.p: Auro Ophir, Job.28.16. בְּכֶתֶם טָהוֹר Auro puro, v.19. Vide זָהָב[?].

נִכְתָּם Niph. Inaurari: Participium, נִכְתָּם עָוֹנְךָ Insigni auro obducat se, vel, Obducta est iniquitas tua coram me, Jerem.2.22. R.Salomon & Chaldaeus, Maculosa est. Nam כֶּתֶם Chaldaicè & apud Rabbinos, Macula, ut R. Salom. notat.
מִכְתָּם m. Aureum κεκμήλιον[?], Psal.16.1. Quidam Instrumenti musici; alii, Carminis Nomen fuisse existimant.
כָּתֹן כְּתֹנֶת f. Tunica: כֻּתֹּנֶת פַּסִּים Tunicam versicolorem, Genes.37.3.
כְּתָנֶת f. Idem, Genes.37.31. Aff. כָּתְנֹו Tunicam ipsius, Genes.37.23. Plural. כְּתֻנּוֹת Tunicae, Exod.28.40. Aff. בִּכְתָנְתָם Cum tunicis suis, Levit.10.5.

כָּתֵף כְּתֵף f. Humerus, Scapula: Latus, Littus, Num.34.11. Aff. כְּתֵפִי Humerus meus, Job 31.22. Plural. כְּתֻפּוֹת Humeralia, Exod.28.7. Constructum[?], וּכְתֻפּוֹת Et latera ostii, Ezech.41.2. Masculinè cum Aff. וּכְתֻפָּיו Humeros suos, Exod. 28.12. כְּתֻפָּיהָ Scapula ejus, 1.Reg.7.34.

כָּתַר Pih. Cinxit: & ex Chaldaico usu, Expectavit. Praeterit. כִּתְּרוּ Cinxerunt, Jud.20.43. כִּתְרוּנִי Cingunt me, Psal.22.13. Imperat. כַּתֵּר־לִי וְעִיר Expecta me paululum, Job.36.2. Hiph. הִכְתִּיר Cinxit, Coronavit. Particip. מְכַתִּיר Circumsidet, Hab.1.4. Futur. יְכַתְּרוּ Cingent, Psal.142.8. וַעֲרוּמִּים יְכַתִּירוּ דַעַת Et astutos coronant scientiâ, Proverb.14.18. vel impersonaliter, Coronantur astuti scientiâ.
כֶּתֶר f. Corona, quasi Cinctura dicta, Esth.II.1.
כְּתָרָת f. Coronamentum, 1.Reg.7.16. Plural. כְּתָרוֹת Coronamenta, ibid.

page.notes: Large headwords (כתן, כתף, כתר) are printed in large Hebrew type and are joined to the first word of their entry. Hebrew and Greek are copied as seen; several Hebrew forms and the Greek word κεκμήλιον are doubtful and are marked [?]. "Constructum" is read from a worn word and marked [?]. Printed "Genef." and "Genes." spellings are left as printed in the references.
